name: ModelVariant822_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant822_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (five spinning projectiles leave five model parts and fly to the opposing slot while their colour fades in, growing twice on the way, then burst there into thirty-two clusters, each flashing an animated spark and scattering eight falling shards that fade and three falling debris sprites, while the ambient level dips during the flight and comes back afterwards); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the projectiles, shards and debris and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 1 once on the frame the projectiles burst, 2 once the last cluster has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-839 and 936 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
